videos.desc: A pale lilac nursery with a white cot under a cream canopy, a round pink rug on the wooden floor and a cream armchair in the corner, filmed from the doorway. A bearded man is kneeling on the floor in an enormous bright yellow ball gown, the wide yellow skirt spread out all around him over the rug. In front of him a golden retriever sits in a red cape with a white ruff. The man leans down to the dog, picks up a yellow rubber bone from the rug and holds it out; the dog takes the yellow bone in its mouth and holds it there while he strokes its head and talks to it, the yellow skirt filling half the frame.

A woman and a man stand side by side in a bright white panelled room in front of a cream sofa, posing to camera. Their matching shirt-and-trouser outfits change from one look to the next: both in deep chocolate brown, then cream with a light brown shirt, then tan brown, then dark brown again, and finally pale grey with a beige shirt. The woman changes her small handbag with every outfit so that it matches, and the two lean together and smile between changes.
videos.said: Remember, taupe with white looks elegant. Wine with camel looks romantic. Mocha with ivory looks soft. Plum with grey looks striking. And sage with cream looks fresh.

videos.desc: Two women pose together in a white panelled room in matching floor-length satin evening gowns with a high slit. The gowns and accessories change from look to look: black gowns with gold heels and small gold bags, then black gowns with bright green heels and a green bag, then chocolate satin gowns with lilac heels and lilac bags, and finally deep red gowns, one with a long cape sleeve, worn with emerald necklace and earrings and a green clutch.
videos.said: Remember, black with gold is expected, but black with deep green looks richer. Chocolate with lavender looks interesting, and red with emerald looks striking.

videos.desc: A couple pose side by side in a white panelled room next to a potted olive tree, changing outfits between shots. They start in matching light blue: she in a light blue satin shirt tied at the waist with white trousers and a light blue bag, he in a light blue linen shirt with white trousers. Then she wears a blue draped top with brown flared trousers while he wears a brown polo with light blue trousers, then both are in chocolate brown and cream, and finally both wear dark green cable-knit jumpers, hers over a camel skirt with tall suede boots, his with camel chinos.
videos.said: Remember, light blue with white looks good, but light blue with brown is unbeatable. Chocolate with cream looks luxurious and forest green with camel looks next level.

videos.desc: A couple pose in a white panelled room, their outfits changing from shot to shot. First she wears an orange halter top with wide white trousers while he wears a white linen shirt with orange trousers. Then she is in an orange vest with navy wide trousers and he in a navy shirt with the same orange trousers. Next both are in pink, hers an off-shoulder puff-sleeved top with grey trousers, his a pink linen shirt with grey trousers. Finally she wears a rust top with a pleated olive skirt and he a sage shirt with rust trousers.
videos.said: Remember, coral with white looks fresh, but coral with teal looks striking. Powder pink with grey looks chic and olive with rust looks rich.

videos.desc: A couple pose together in a white panelled room in front of a cream sofa. In the first look she wears a deep red satin gown and he an all-black shirt and trousers. Then she wears a sleeveless white tiered cotton dress with white heels while he wears an olive shirt with cream trousers, and they turn to face each other. In the last look she wears a long fitted black dress with black heels and he a tan shirt with dark brown trousers, his arm around her waist.
videos.said: Remember, if she is wearing red, he goes all black. Main character energy. If she wears white, olive and cream, old money. And if she wears black, taupe and chocolate, quiet luxury.

videos.desc: A woman in a plain white shirt and black trousers stands in a clothes shop between rails of colourful dresses. One by one she puts on shining gold pieces: big gold hoop earrings, then fine gold chains at her neck, then a thick stack of gold bangles on her wrist, then a red belt with a heavy gold buckle. She finishes the look with a wide straw hat, sunglasses and two bags and presents herself to the camera.

In a sunlit bedroom a bare-chested young man picks up a light blue shirt and pulls it on. He fastens the buttons one by one down the front, then swings a navy suit jacket over his shoulders and pushes his arms into the sleeves. He knots and straightens a dark tie at his collar, tugs the jacket into place, and finally stands in front of a mirror in the full suit, adjusting the tie one last time.

A heavy bearded man sits bare-chested in a small wooden sauna wearing a thick grey fur hat with ear flaps and a white towel around his waist. In front of him a pit of grey stones glows orange in the middle. He reaches for a wooden bucket at his side, lifts a wooden ladle of water and tips it over the hot stones. A thick cloud of white steam bursts up and fills the whole cabin until he almost disappears in it. He sits back grinning and gasping, waving a hand through the steam, with a snowy window behind him.

An outdoor garden party on a lawn, with a floral arch, string lights and a cream sofa behind. Guests in summer dresses and pale suits stand in a group; several of the women wear dark sunglasses. One by one the women swoon and sag at the knees while the others grab them under the arms and hold them up. A man in a beige suit fans himself with a white plate. By the end everyone is lying on the grass and on cushions, still fanning themselves with plates.

A woman in pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair kneels on a wide white bed in a high-rise flat and folds washing. She holds up a tie-dye t-shirt, lays it flat and folds it, then folds a grey lace top. A wicker basket of clean washing sits beside her. The folded items grow into neat stacks, and by the end the whole bed is walled in by tall towers of folded clothes in every colour.

Close on two hands in a living room stitching a dark button onto the front of a pale blue shirt with a needle. Cut to a workroom where dark hands push a fine needle through the folded hem of a piece of natural linen, with spools of coloured thread on the shelf behind. Then a sewing machine foot runs a line of stitches along a folded cream panel. Next an embroidery hoop holds a big pink and red flower worked in coloured threads with green leaves. Finally a row of people in a hall lift a finished patchwork quilt above their heads and cheer.
videos.said: There we go. Nice and even. Pretty. Ta-da!

videos.desc: A young woman works at a laptop in a bright home office and raises one finger asking for quiet as she talks. Behind her a young man slips past the doorway, then another man carries a box through. Then an entire marching band files into the room in matching navy, orange and light blue uniforms, playing trumpets, a trombone, a sousaphone and a bass drum. She throws her hands up and shouts in disbelief while the band plays on around her desk.

A first-person ride down a water slide: bare legs in colourful swim shorts race feet-first through a blue chute past palm trees and a bright sky, then down a green flume into a burst of white water; the shot ends on the whole waterslide tower above a busy pool.

A young man in a packed football stadium films himself in the stands. His face is painted in two halves, blue-yellow and red, and a long striped team scarf in club colours hangs around his neck over his shirt. A wide shot shows the ring of the stadium full of fans with a flag being waved on a pole. He shouts and screams with joy, the fans around him leap up and hold a scarf overhead, and he ends hugging a friend and roaring at the camera.

A hand holds a metal bottle under a thin fall of water trickling off a mossy cliff and fills it; then a woman in a bright red hooded raincoat with an orange backpack walks along a wet path, reaches into the spray of a small waterfall, and finally stands in front of a huge waterfall, mouth open, looking up at it.

A smiling man in a yellow high-visibility vest pulled on over his t-shirt stands on a terracotta tiled roof above an Italian old town; the camera pans away from him across a sea of red-tiled roofs, bell towers and a green dome under a clear blue sky, then comes back to him as he throws an arm out toward the view.

Two young women in a bedroom hung with fairy lights play tug-of-war over a lilac hooded sweatshirt, both laughing. They then bunch it up between them and pull faces at a phone held out at arm's length for a selfie. In the last third they sit on the bed and one plaits the other's hair while she gives a thumbs-up.

A woman in checked pyjamas and a beige cardigan stands barefoot on a cold tiled hallway floor, hopping from foot to foot and hugging herself, shivering. A close-up shows her feet stepping into a pair of white fluffy sheep-face slippers on the wooden floor. She then walks comfortably down the hallway towards the camera in the slippers, relaxed and smiling.

A young woman in a walk-in wardrobe lifts a loose peach-coloured women's shirt with ruffles down the front off the rail and holds it up in front of her, sniffing it and smiling. She sprays it with a small glass atomiser, then takes a large white spray bottle and mists the whole rail of hanging clothes, walking along the rack from the pale shirts to the bright dresses. At the end she stands back in the middle of the wardrobe, phone in hand, looking pleased at the rows of clothes.

A battered pram with patched fabric and rusty wheels rolls along a park path. Then a woman in a beige blazer pushes a plain modern grey stroller with a small fluffy dog sitting in it and the caption 500 euro appears. Finally a man in white robes pushes an ornate chrome carriage-style stroller with buttoned leather upholstery, the same dog inside wearing sunglasses, captioned 5000 euro, while the woman stares open-mouthed.

In a bright clothing boutique lined with rails of coats, a woman poses for the camera in one outfit after another. She is first dressed in an oversized denim jacket and a colourful scarf, then in a long red coat, then in a silver sequinned mini dress, then in a thick knitted coat, and finally in an enormous feathered coat with a matching feather hat. Between each look the shot cuts and she is dressed in the next piece.

In a small shoe shop with wooden shelves of boots, pendant lamps and a worn wooden floor covered in open boxes and tissue paper, a smiling young woman with a long blonde braid, in a white top and dark jeans, sits on a stool in a pair of burgundy knee-high boots. White trainers lie on the floor. She stands up and walks a few steps in the boots, looking down at them. A shop assistant in a blue T-shirt holds yet another box, and a young man in a green T-shirt on a bench holds up one more shoe.

In a boot shop with wooden shelves stacked with boots and boxes and a worn wooden floor, a young woman with long dark hair, in a taupe ribbed top and dark jeans, bends down from a stool and laces up a pair of sturdy brown leather boots. She laughs as her hair swings and glances back into the shop, still bent over the boots. Many other black and brown boots stand around her feet. A smiling shop assistant with a yellow tape measure around his neck kneels beside her, and a few customers watch from the back.

In an elegant tailor's shop with dark wooden cabinets full of folded cloth and green glass lamps, a young man in a navy suit stands on a low wooden box and looks down while a smiling young woman in a navy pinstripe top and cream trousers fastens the button of his jacket. Beside her a golden retriever wearing a small navy waistcoat sits holding a wooden tray with a red pincushion in its mouth. At the end she straightens up and pats the dog's head. A patterned red rug covers the wooden parquet floor.

In a busy street market under red and green awnings, in low golden light, a young woman with long dark hair walks confidently away down the aisle in a camel coat and matching beige trousers and white trainers. She looks back over her shoulder, turns round to face the camera, smiles and lowers her sunglasses. Around her people turn to stare: a fishmonger in a blue apron, an older woman with a handbag, a man by a bicycle and men by the fruit stall. An apple lies on the ground next to some straw.

In a bright office lobby with a glass roof, a white marble floor, large potted fig trees and a revolving door, three people in plain black suits walk in a line holding takeaway coffee cups. Among them a young woman with a high blonde ponytail, in a bright yellow suit, yellow top and white trainers, walks along smiling, sips from a green drink and carries a yellow bag, moving ahead of the others towards the front. A reception desk with white lilies stands nearby, and sunlight streams in.

Backstage in a theatre, a young man in black trousers and a white waistcoat stands with his arms out while a dresser behind him pulls a gold sequinned jacket off his arm and drops it on the floor, then helps him into a black tailcoat. A young woman in black kneels to fix his trouser leg, and by the red stage curtain another woman in black holds up two fingers as a signal. A mirror framed with round bulbs, a rail of costumes and a pair of black shoes on the wooden floor surround them.

Inside a bright optician's shop, a young man in a white coat over a navy shirt stands behind a glass display counter, trying on a pair of glasses with thick red-brown rims and grinning. He takes them off, leans over the counter to talk to a woman in a beige trench coat who laughs with her hand at her mouth, and then puts the glasses back on. The wall behind him is covered in rows of empty glasses on wooden rails, more lie in the counter, and another man works at a desk behind.

A mirror selfie in a pink shop fitting room with a dark green velvet curtain on a gold rail. A young woman with long braids and gold hoop earrings wears a short silver sequin dress and holds up her phone, grimacing with clenched teeth as she twists one arm behind her back, unable to reach the zip; she gives up for a moment, touches her hair, then tries again. Other dresses hang on hooks on the wall, a round gold stool holds folded jeans and a tote bag, and sandals sit on the wooden floor.

A mirror selfie in a vintage clothes shop with brick walls and mustard fitting-room curtains. A smiling young man in a very loud tropical shirt with bright parrots and flowers over a white T-shirt holds up his phone with a hand on his hip. Beside him a young woman in a green cardigan and black skirt puts a hand on her chest, holds out her other palm and pulls a doubtful face. He looks down at his shirt and his smile turns into a frown. A clothes rail, a straw hat, a pink armchair and a palm plant stand behind.

A rooftop bar at dusk with string lights and tall towers behind. Two young women stand side by side wearing exactly the same green satin mini dress, the same small gold shoulder bag and the same gold strappy sandals. They point at each other's outfits, laugh, look down at the dresses and finally give each other a high five. A young man behind a copper bar pours a drink, and olive trees in pots and rattan seats stand on the wooden deck.

A snowy shopping street in winter, with fairy lights on the shop fronts, a small Christmas tree and a tram. A grinning young man walks proudly towards the camera down the icy pavement in a huge white fluffy coat, a bright pink feather boa and a yellow knitted beanie, swinging the coat open to show it off. Behind him a young woman waves her scarf, and a group of young women in dark coats watch him, cover their mouths and laugh.

An old-fashioned fabric shop with dark wooden shelves full of rolled cloth, glass jars and a brass chandelier. A smiling young woman in a maroon jumper holds the end of a long blue ribbon of fabric to the tip of her nose and stretches her other arm out straight to measure it to her fingertips. A young man at the counter, beside a navy bolt of cloth and a long wooden measuring stick, looks up and smiles, then cuts the fabric with scissors while she holds it.
